notes:
CIRCUIT: 20 V DC source feeding a 10 ohm series resistor into a four-branch parallel bank (5 ohm, 5 F, 6 kohm, 4 mH) between a top rail (y~375) and a bottom rail (y~620); the bottom rail is grounded under the capacitor. 7 components, 3 nets.

NET MAP:
  n1 = left vertical wire: + (top) terminal of V-DC #5 at (180,489) up to the top-left corner (180,375) and east to the left lead of R #0 (10 ohm) at (231,378). Two terminals: 5.0, 0.0.
  n2 = top rail y~375 from the right lead of R #0 (310,378) east to the corner at (750,375). Carries the top terminals of R #1 (5 ohm, 363,451), C #4 (5 F, 486,470), R #3 (6 kohm, 615,452) and L #2 (4 mH, 750,451). Five terminals.
  0  = bottom rail y~620 from the V-DC bottom terminal (180,551) east to (750,552), plus the GND stub dropping at x~490 to GND #6 (490,634). Carries the bottom terminals of R #1, C #4, R #3, L #2, V-DC #5 and GND #6. Six terminals.

JUDGEMENT CALLS (all six CRITICAL sites): every one is an unambiguous T, not an X - the branch wire terminates on the rail and does not continue past it, so there is no crossing reading available. Confirmed in the 5x site crops.
  S2 (357,379) - top of R #1 (5 ohm) meets the top rail. T from below; explicit junction. Reading it as anything else would strand the 5 ohm branch.
  S1 (481,378) - top of C #4 meets the top rail (dot score 1.8, the fattest on the sheet). T from below; junction.
  S0 (608,374) - top of R #3 (6 kohm) meets the top rail. T from below; junction.
  S16 (370,618) - bottom of R #1 meets the bottom rail. T from above; junction.
  S15 (490,615) - deg 4: bottom of C #4 comes down from above, the bottom rail runs left-right, and the GND stub continues down to GND #6. All four branches are one node either way (the through-branch and the stub are the same wire), so junction; the alternative crossing reading would leave GND on a one-terminal net, which rule 1 forbids.
  S14 (621,612) - bottom of R #3 meets the bottom rail. T from above; junction.
Non-critical sites S3-S7 (the '10 ohm' caption touching R #0's leads), S9/S10 ('5F' caption touching C #4) and S12/S13 ('5 ohm' caption touching R #1) are handwriting ink crossing wire, left at default; none of them changes the netlist.

PORTS/CLASSES: no overrides. Every class matches the drawn symbol (zig-zag resistors #0/#1/#3, coil #2, parallel-plate cap #4, circle-with-plus-minus source #5, ground rake #6). C #4's port candidates p2 (510,500) and p3 (512,508) are strokes of the handwritten '5F' label, not leads - the tracer already ignores them and t0/t1 sit on the real vertical plates leads. No 3-terminal parts, so no pin ordering to check. Nothing unresolved.
